headline: Mercado Bitcoin Resumes Crypto Trading Two Weeks After Cyber Incident
summary: Brazilian cryptocurrency exchange Mercado Bitcoin resumed buying and selling operations two weeks after a cyberattack diverted more than 200 million reais.
why: Cryptocurrency exchange security and operational continuity are crucial for maintaining investor confidence in regional digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Mercado Bitcoin
impacts.why: Resuming platform trading restores liquidity access for exchange clients.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
